about.missionText: Huanyu Cloud Medical is the world's first PLG-driven cross-border medical intelligence engine. We do one thing: make world-class healthcare truly accessible.

v1.title: 01 Full Transparency
v1.desc: Real-time treatment dashboard makes every step visible; itemized billing eliminates hidden costs; family sync keeps loved ones informed.

v2.title: 02 AI Matching + Expert Review
v2.desc: NLP technology objectively analyzes your condition from 2000+ accredited hospitals. Each plan is double-reviewed by Associate Chief Physicians or above.

v3.title: 03 Full-cycle Post-treatment Care
v3.desc: Monthly follow-ups by dedicated medical advisors; remote cloud consultations across borders; complete rehabilitation records archived.

v4.title: 04 Zero-risk Decision Journey
v4.desc: Free feasibility pre-assessment with no payment required. Only proceed when you are fully satisfied — the choice is always yours.

v5.title: 05 Compliance & Emergency Response
v5.desc: 98.5% medical translation accuracy; anomaly alert system triggers immediately; intelligent compliance monitoring throughout your journey.
